# Rajvee Cab - Gujarat Cab & Taxi Service

> Rajvee Cab is Gujarat's premier 24x7 cab and outstation taxi service, headquartered at Greenland Chokdi, Rajkot. Specializing in affordable one-way drops with ZERO return fare, round-trip intercity cabs, and reliable 24x7 airport transfers for Rajkot Hirasar International Airport and Ahmedabad SVPI Airport.

## Quick Facts
- Business Name: Rajvee Cab (also known as Rajvee Travels)
- Primary Phone: +91 97378 72972 (Call & WhatsApp 24x7)
- Headquarters Address: Greenland Chokdi, Rajkot, Gujarat 360003, India
- Hours: Open 24 Hours, 7 Days a Week, 365 Days a Year
- Official Website: https://rajvee-cab.github.io/
- Service Coverage: All 33 districts of Gujarat including Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Gandhinagar, Jamnagar, Bhavnagar, Junagadh, Morbi, Somnath, Dwarka, Bhuj, Statue of Unity, and Mumbai.

## Fleet & Rates
- Swift Dzire / Hyundai Aura (Sedan, 4+1): ₹11 - ₹12 / KM. Ideal for airport drops, couples, and small families.
- Maruti Ertiga (SUV, 6+1): ₹14 - ₹15 / KM. Ideal for family vacations, groups, and outstation trips.
- Toyota Innova Crysta (Premium SUV, 7+1): ₹18 - ₹20 / KM. Ideal for VIP corporate travel, executive transfers, and long luxury tours.

## Core Services
- One-Way Outstation Drops: Pay only for one-sided kilometers. Zero return fare.
- 24x7 Airport Transfers: Punctual pickups and drops for Rajkot Hirasar Airport (HSR) and Ahmedabad Airport (AMD) with free flight tracking.
- Round-Trip & Saurashtra Pilgrimage Tours: Dedicated chauffeurs for Somnath Jyotirlinga, Dwarka Dham, Gir National Park, and Statue of Unity.
- Local City Rentals: Flexible hourly packages for business, hospital visits, and events in Rajkot.
